model_annotation: This line plot illustrates the trends in three distinct policy areas—“Wirtschaftspolitik insgesamt” (overall economic policy), “Finanzpolitik” (financial policy), and “Handelspolitik” (trade policy)—from 2016 to 2024, using a dual-axis system to accommodate different scales. The x-axis represents time, spanning from 2016 to 2024, with tick marks at two-year intervals. The y-axis on the left, labeled “Index,” ranges from 0 to 1,000 and is used for the black line (“Wirtschaftspolitik insgesamt”) and the light blue line (“Finanzpolitik”), while the y-axis on the right, also labeled “Index,” ranges from 0 to 9,000 and is used for the magenta line (“Handelspolitik”). The black line starts near 100 in 2016, rises sharply to a peak of approximately 500 around 2020, then declines to about 100 by 2024. The light blue line follows a similar pattern, starting near 50, peaking around 450 in 2020, and ending near 100 in 2024. The magenta line remains very low on its right-side scale, starting near 0, rising slightly to about 1,000 around 2020, then dropping again before surging to nearly 8,000 by 2024.
